title: CMake Patterns for Audio Development
description: Common CMake patterns for audio plugin development including testing, CI/CD, and cross-platform builds
markdown:
# CMake Patterns for Audio Development

## Testing with Catch2

```cmake
# Enable testing
enable_testing()

# Fetch Catch2
FetchContent_Declare(
    Catch2
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2.git
    GIT_TAG v3.5.0
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(Catch2)

# Test executable
add_executable(MyPluginTests
    tests/DSPTests.cpp
    tests/ProcessorTests.cpp
)

target_link_libraries(MyPluginTests PRIVATE
    Catch2::Catch2
    juce::juce_audio_processors
)

# Register tests
add_test(NAME MyPluginTests COMMAND MyPluginTests)
```

## CI/CD Configuration

```cmake
# Detect CI environment
if(DEFINED ENV{CI})
    message(STATUS "Running in CI environment")
    
    # Use consistent settings
    set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
    
    # Enable warnings as errors
    if(MSVC)
        add_compile_options(/W4 /WX)
    else()
        add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Werror)
    endif()
endif()
```

## Cross-Platform Plugin Output

```cmake
function(setup_plugin_output PLUGIN_NAME)
    if(APPLE)
        set(VST3_OUTPUT ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3)
        set(AU_OUTPUT ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components)
    elseif(WIN32)
        set(VST3_OUTPUT $ENV{LOCALAPPDATA}/Programs/Common/VST3)
    else()
        set(VST3_OUTPUT ~/.vst3)
        set(LV2_OUTPUT ~/.lv2)
    endif()
    
    # Set per-format output
    if(TARGET ${PLUGIN_NAME}_VST3)
        set_target_properties(${PLUGIN_NAME}_VST3 PROPERTIES
            LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${VST3_OUTPUT}"
        )
    endif()
endfunction()
```

## Release Build Optimization

```cmake
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release")
    if(MSVC)
        # MSVC optimizations
        target_compile_options(MyPlugin PRIVATE /O2 /GL)
        target_link_options(MyPlugin PRIVATE /LTCG)
    else()
        # GCC/Clang optimizations
        target_compile_options(MyPlugin PRIVATE
            -O3
            -march=native
            -ffast-math
            -fno-exceptions
        )
    endif()
endif()
```
